name: a tagged link types on with a live character count
looks: On a near-black field a small eyebrow label and a character counter sit above a long tracking URL typing on in mono, one character at a time, with a blinking cursor at the live position. A dashboard card begins to fade in at the edge of frame as the string finishes.
build: DOM mono text revealed per character with kit.typeOn; the character counter is set from the live string length with no easing, same mechanic as live-readout-hud; the cursor is a blinking ::after block at the live position.
sound: A soft mechanical key tick per character, lighter than a kinetic word hit.
prompt: Type a long tracking URL on character by character in mono on a near-black field, with a small live character counter ticking up above it and a blinking cursor at the live position, as the next scene's card begins to fade in at the edge.
